'''2005 World Championship Day 3 consolation David Destefanis DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David Destefanis]] at [[2005 World Championship]] (Day 3 consolation); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by David "Lirkas 'DDM'" Destefanis (2005-08-31).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35121 Europe - SYCFA Manipulation - Day 3]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061106122123/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35121&PHPSESSID=29818f8b6da266174ddd746571e9b090 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Day 3 consolation deck, also used at the 2005 European Championship (post titled "Europe"); filed under 2005 Worlds. Bill to rule on the event.<ref name="src" />
